project.name: k1.lib-html
project.description: PHP 8.2+ library for generating HTML documents using an object-oriented, DOM-like approach

nodes.name: tag.php
nodes.summary: Base class for all HTML elements. Manages attributes, child collections, inline tag resolution, and HTML generation. Every tag instance is registered in tag_catalog and receives a unique ID. Contains constants for self-closing behavior, append positions, and insert positions. Uses append_shotcuts trait.

nodes.name: html_document.php
nodes.summary: Root HTML element that extends tag. Automatically creates head and body children. Sets tag::$root to itself. Represents the full HTML document structure.

nodes.name: DOM.php
nodes.summary: Static compatibility wrapper for k1lib v1 code. Provides static methods to start, manage, and generate HTML documents. Acts as a facade for html_document.

nodes.name: tag_catalog.php
nodes.summary: Static registry that assigns unique IDs to all tag instances. Enables inline tag embedding and object lookup by ID. Provides increase(), get_by_index(), index_exist(), decatalog() methods.

nodes.name: tag_log.php
nodes.summary: Optional global action logger. Enabled via html_document::set_use_log(true). Logs tag creation, cloning, appending, and generation operations.

nodes.name: append_shotcuts.php
nodes.summary: Trait that provides fluent append methods (append_div, append_p, append_span, etc.) on any tag. Allows method chaining for child element creation.

nodes.name: template.php
nodes.summary: Static class for loading PHP template files from a configured directory. Provides enable(), load_template(), template_exist() methods.

nodes.name: tag
nodes.summary: Core HTML tag abstraction class. Manages attributes, child collections (head, main, tail), inline tag resolution, and HTML generation. All HTML elements inherit from this class.

nodes.name: html_document
nodes.summary: Root HTML document class extending tag. Creates head and body children automatically. Provides head() and body() accessor methods.

nodes.name: DOM
nodes.summary: Static compatibility wrapper for k1lib v1. Provides static methods for HTML document management: start(), end(), html(), html_document(), generate().

nodes.name: tag_catalog
nodes.summary: Static registry for tag instances. Manages unique ID assignment and lookup. Key methods: increase(), get_by_index(), index_exist(), decatalog(), get_catalog().

nodes.name: append_shotcuts
nodes.summary: Trait providing fluent child appending methods: append_div(), append_p(), append_span(), append_ul(), append_li(), append_i(), append_pre(), append_a(), append_img(), append_h1()-append_h6(), append_label().

nodes.name: template
nodes.summary: Static template loading system. Enables template engine, loads PHP templates from configured path. Methods: enable(), is_enabled(), load_template(), template_exist(), error_500().

nodes.name: on_DOM
nodes.summary: Notification system component. Extends common_code. Renders messages as Bootstrap alerts in the DOM. Methods: queue_mesasage(), queue_title(), insert_messases_on_DOM().

nodes.name: common_code

nodes.name: HTML Generation
nodes.summary: Core module for generating HTML documents using an object-oriented DOM-like approach. Tag classes render to HTML strings via generate() method.

nodes.name: Tag Catalog & ID Management
nodes.summary: System for cataloging tag instances with unique IDs. Enables inline tag embedding and lookup via tag_catalog static registry.

nodes.name: Child Element Management
nodes.summary: System for managing child elements with three collections: head, main, and tail. Supports fluent API via append_shotcuts trait.

nodes.name: Notifications System
nodes.summary: Session-based message queue for user notifications. Components: common_code base class, on_DOM renderer.

nodes.name: Tag Inheritance Pattern
nodes.summary: All HTML elements inherit from the base tag class. Each tag class calls parent::__construct() with tag name and self-closed flag.

nodes.name: Fluent API
nodes.summary: Method chaining pattern used throughout the library. Most setter methods return $this for chaining. append_shotcuts trait provides fluent child creation.

nodes.name: Inline Tag Embedding
nodes.summary: Tag objects can be embedded in text values. __toString() returns {{ID:N}} placeholder which is replaced during generate() via parse_value().

nodes.name: Three-Collection Child System
nodes.summary: Tags maintain three child arrays: childs_head (rendered first), childs (main), childs_tail (rendered last). Allows fine-grained control over element ordering.

tour.title: Introduction to k1.lib-html
tour.description: k1.lib-html is a PHP library for generating HTML documents using an object-oriented, DOM-like approach. Every HTML tag is represented as a PHP object that can be nested, queried, and rendered to a string.

tour.title: Base Tag Class Architecture
tour.description: The tag class is the foundation of the entire library. It manages attributes, child collections (head, main, tail), and HTML generation. Each tag instance is registered in tag_catalog with a unique ID.

tour.title: HTML Element Classes
tour.description: All HTML elements (div, span, p, a, img, input, table, etc.) extend the base tag class. Each class calls parent::__construct() with the tag name and a self-closed flag.

tour.title: Child Element Management
tour.description: Tags maintain three child collections: childs_head (rendered first), childs (main), and childs_tail (rendered last). The append_shotcuts trait provides fluent methods like append_div(), append_p() for adding children.

tour.title: Inline Tag Embedding
tour.description: Tag objects can be embedded in text values. When a tag is used as a string, __toString() returns a {{ID:N}} placeholder which is replaced during generate() via parse_value().

tour.title: Document Structure
tour.description: html_document extends tag and represents the root <html> element. It automatically creates head and body children. DOM is a static compatibility wrapper for k1lib v1 code.

tour.title: Notifications System
tour.description: Session-based message queue for user notifications. common_code provides base functionality, on_DOM renders messages as Bootstrap alerts in the DOM.

tour.title: Template System
tour.description: Static template class for loading PHP template files from a configured directory. Uses DOM class internally for error handling.
